newsitem.title: USA: PriceCostco Q4 net shr $0.42 vs $0.35.
newsitem.headline: PriceCostco Q4 net shr $0.42 vs $0.35.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is PriceCostco Inc.
1996 Q4 and FY figures ended September 1, while 1995 Q4 and FY figures ended September 3.

The company's reported net income in fiscal 1995 of $.68 per share reflected a non-cash charge of $83.4 million, or $0.37 per share, that was taken in the second quarter of fiscal 1995 as a result of the final calculation of the loss on the spin-off of Price Enterprises Inc.

A LIFO benefit of $7.5 million recorded in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996 compares to a LIFO charge of $2.0 million recorded in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1995 -- a quarter-over-quarter benefit to earnings of $9.5 million (pre-tax) or $0.03 per share.

The 1996 fiscal year fourth quarter's SG&A expenses include a $5.2 million charge to true-up the employee bonus accrual, which covers bonuses payable to more than 700 employees participating in the company's bonus plan. In contrast, during the fourth quarter of fiscal 1995, a $6.0 million reduction to the employee bonus accrual resulted in a benefit to SG&A expenses in that period -- overall, a quarter-over-quarter reduction in earnings of $11.2 million (pre-tax) or $0.03 per share.
